title: Will Tyler Cameron and their partner be eliminated from Dancing with the Stars Season 35 before Oct 21, 2026?
rules: If Tyler Cameron and their partner are officially eliminated from Dancing with the Stars Season 35 before Oct 21, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
The declaration must be made through official program broadcast, website, verified social media, or press releases.
If the season is canceled without declaring eliminations, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Elimination includes being voted off, evicted, knocked out, removed from further contention, voluntary withdrawal, disqualification, or producer removal.
Multiple simultaneous eliminations count.
Initial elimination counts even if the contestant later returns.

Doesn't count for payout
Eliminations immediately reversed in the same episode don't count.
Temporary suspensions, medical holds, or being runner-up in the finale don't count as elimination.

blind.reasoning: Only one episode (Week 6, Oct 20, probably a single elimination among 10 couples) remains before the market closes. Tyler was in the bottom two in Week 5 even though two couples scored lower, so his fan vote is weak and he is one of the likeliest to go. His emotional Dedication Night tribute to his late mother, improving scores, and Guillermo's fans voting elsewhere could keep him safe, so I put him below even odds.
blind.falsifier: Tyler and Sharna are announced safe at the end of the October 20 Dedication Night episode (or no elimination occurs that night), which would resolve NO.

leak_matches: 10% base rate but below even odds

final.reasoning: The liquid market at 0.24 makes me shade my estimate down, but Tyler's Week 5 bottom-two finish despite outscoring two couples points to weak fan votes. That supports about 30% for the single remaining episode, modestly above the 0.26 ask.
